palettes.scope: colorindices; use target emulator RGB palette; data does not prove a variant naturally occurs

metatiles.invalid_ids: Do not export data obtained by running beyond these static tables as semantic metatiles.

player.ordinary_direction: direction1 is right; direction2 swaps each row pair and sets0x40 on each tile
player.forced_symmetry: offset0x50/0xB8/0xC0 force bottom-row attrs to left0/right0x40;0xC8 forces bottom two rows; killed game routine0x0B forces bottom two rows
player.small_crop: small cells have blank first16pixels; crop only with retained logicalYoffset16
player.swim_extra: When SwimmingFlag !=0 and Player_State !=0 and (FrameCounter &4)==0: replace sprite6 when facing right, sprite7 when facing left with tile0x31 if big. If small, skip when current selected tile==0x48, otherwise tile0x46. Preserve original per-tile attributes.
player.throw_overlay: At eligible FireballThrowingTimer phase, rerender tableoffset0x58 over all4rows if stationary, first3rows if moving; retain existing bottomrow for moving case.

palette.ppu_stream: [address_hi,address_lo,control,payload...] repeated until address_hi==0;control bits0..5=length,bit6=repeat1payload byte,bit7=increment32 instead1
palette.runtime_updates: Apply area32colors, player override at3F10, optional background overrides at3F00 and animated palette3 at3F0C. Sprite actor palette selection may cycle0..3 for star/fire-flower effects.
palette.ppu_mirror: 3F10/14/18/1C mirror3F00/04/08/0C; every background pixelindex0 uses universal3F00; sprite pixelindex0 is transparent.
palette.rgb: Palette tables store NES6bit color indices, not RGB. Reuse the target emulator palette or declare an RGB conversion choice; no unique original ROM RGB palette exists.

enemy.raw_vs_assembled: Raw43cells are complete static records. Their actual per-tile flips, attributes, animation, defeat swaps and visibility depend on EnemyGfxHandler and state; raw grid alone is not a canonical sprite.
enemy.code_map: EnemyGfxTableOffsets/EnemyAttributeData indexed by adjusted graphics code, not all raw Enemy_ID values.33bullet->08;35retainer/princess->15;BowserGfxFlag1->16 and2->17;32jumpspring->18..1A.
enemy.bowser: front cells at offsetsD2,DE;rearD8,E4; rearX=frontX+16 facingleft or-16 facingright;rearY=frontY+8. Body bit7 selects mouth/front2,bit0 selects rear2. Palette override BowserPaletteData writes spritepalette1.

scope: Every table generated from caller ROM, checked by its source-bound SHA. Player/special descriptors derive from matching static source; enemy grids require state-dependent postprocessing. No runtimeCPU/pixel validation claimed.
